:''The correct title of this article is '''Are you going to San Fierro?'''. It appears incorrectly here because of technical restrictions.''

After the cut-scene, you have five and a half minutes to burn all the evidence. Be careful not the step into the flames, unless you've already completed the [[../Firefighter/]] mission, so that you're fireproof. If you run out of ammo for the flame-thrower, there are extra near the Truth's van. After this, you are given an RPG, and have to shoot down a police helicopter. Now just drive to the garage in Doherty, San Fierro to complete the mission.

== Rewards ==
* '''Respect''': +15
* '''Weapon''': RPG
* Zip clothing stores now open.
* Most properties in San Fierro now available for purchase.
* Remote Explosives and Country Rifle available at Ammu-Nation.
* The tram will now appear around San Fierro.
* You can now save your progress at the Doherty Garage.
* You can now store up to 5 vehicles in the Garage in Doherty.
